machine: 2x Xeon Gold 5122 (8 cores, 2 NUMA nodes), 183 GiB DDR4-2666, Quadro RTX 6000 24 GB (PCIe Gen3 x16) + RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB (PCIe Gen3 x8)
prompt: Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle.
note: Decode tok/s as each engine reports it. Both are rates per decode step after the prompt: llama-server's timings.predicted_per_second counts 127 timed steps for its 128 predicted tokens (the first is sampled at the end of prompt processing); Tarfa times 128 decode steps after the token sampled from the prompt (129 tokens of text). MTP counts 128 tokens over its verify steps. The comparison uses the 2026-11-07 session, in which both engines ran back to back on the same build and routing prior. The model file is larger than RAM, so llama.cpp's speed depends on what the page cache holds; its slowest runs are mostly the first after a load.

checks_2026_11_09.note: Check runs of the published launchers (run_best.sh, run_spec.sh), not part of the comparison. MTP run 1 used the 2026-11-07 routing prior; MTP run 2 and both plain runs used a new prior from run_calib.sh. Plain run 2 used the final CPU kernel (NUMA row split with remainder-safe bounds; the same split on two nodes).
